## Claude Haiku 5.5 API

Claude Haiku 5.5 is a large language model by Anthropic, available on the Venice API as `claude-haiku-5-5`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Claude Haiku 5.5 is built for high-volume, latency-sensitive work such as classification, routing, extraction, and subagent tasks. It features a 1M token context window, 128K max output tokens, adaptive thinking, and strong document and vision understanding.

### Claude Haiku 5.5 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-haiku-5-5` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.10 / $0.50 per 1M |

### Claude Haiku 5.5 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Anthropic |
| Released | Oct 7, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max |

### How to use the Claude Haiku 5.5 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "claude-haiku-5-5"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "claude-haiku-5-5",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "medium"
  }'
```
